items.title: Trump reinstates Iran port blockade and vows 20% charge on cargo passing through Hormuz
items.description: The US president also says Washington will impose a 20% charge on all cargo shipped through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Briton tells of surviving Spain wildfire in car as wife and friends died trying to run to safety
items.description: Malcolm Timbrell's wife and their friends are thought to have died when a devastating wildfire tore through their village in Spain.

items.title: Hungary parliament votes to remove president from office
items.description: Tamás Sulyok was widely seen as a loyalist of former prime minister Viktor Orbán, who lost power in April after 16 years.

items.title: At least 28 killed, 25 critically injured after fire engulfs Bangkok bar
items.description: Firefighters arrived at the scene in the Chatuchak district to find patrons running through flames to escape.

items.title: 'Hero, legend, sweetheart': Tributes to Jurassic Park actor Sam Neill, who has died aged 78
items.description: Friends, politicians and fellow film stars remember Neill following his "sudden and unexpected" death.

items.title: Wildfire raging south of Paris could have been set deliberately, says minister
items.description: The interior minister has said the fire near Paris could have been set deliberately and two people have been arrested.

items.title: Lindsey Graham's sister chosen as replacement after senator's death
items.description: The South Carolina governor chose the senator's little sister to serve out the rest of his term after Graham's death on Saturday.

items.title: UK-Switzerland deal to scrap roaming charges and allow Britons to use e-gates
items.description: The UK signs a new services deal with Switzerland it says will increase exports by £5.2bn annually "in the long run".

items.title: German court convicts Iraqi couple of enslaving Yazidi girls
items.description: The pair, named only as Twana H.S. and Asia R. A., left Germany for Iraq in 2015 and became members of the Islamic State group.

items.title: Sudan's paramilitary RSF chief sentenced to death over war crimes
items.description: Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo was convicted in absentia along with 15 RSF commanders and allies.

items.title: Ted Lasso actor Fernandez makes professional debut
items.description: Ted Lasso actor Cristo Fernandez makes his professional football debut for American second-tier side El Paso Locomotive.

items.title: Men disguised as police kill Ecuadorean drug lord's brother
items.description: The victim, David Macías, was the brother of drug lord 'El Fito', who is awaiting trial in the US.
